interpretation_boundary.SupportsAt_required_meaning: SupportsAt f x g means: for every y in the whole carrier E, f x + inner g (y-x) <= f y. Inner-product symmetry is harmless over the real carrier.
interpretation_boundary.reason: The bounded packet contains the literal-definition assertion but not the definition body. This report assesses the sealed formulas under the required interpretation, not the actual local definition. A later semantic packet must provide sufficient definition context.
interpretation_boundary.supplied_vector_semantics: The vectors are inputs satisfying the supporting inequality at the iterates. No theorem asserting existence of subgradients at arbitrary points is used or certified.

mathematical_reconstruction.notation: q_i=||x_i-z||^2, delta_i=f(x_i)-f(z), A_N=sum_{i<N} a_i, B_N=sum_{i<N} a_i^2. For N>0, S_N={f(x_i):i<N} and m_N=min S_N=sInf S_N.

norm_bound.source_route: Lines 83-118 assume ||g||>G, infer ||g||>0, and test the global support at y=x+g/||g||. The support gives f(y)-f(x)>=||g|| and Lipschitz growth gives f(y)-f(x)<=G, a contradiction.
norm_bound.alternative_route: Test instead at y=x+g. Then ||g||^2<=f(x+g)-f(x)<=G||g||. If ||g||=0 the conclusion is immediate; otherwise divide by ||g||. This route is sufficient on its own and does not require G>0.
not_required: Existence of any other supporting vector

weighted_intermediate.support_use: delta_i<=inner(g_i,x_i-z); multiplying by 2*a_i is order-preserving when a_i>=0. The norm bound gives a_i^2*||g_i||^2<=G^2*a_i^2.
weighted_intermediate.zero_horizon: At N=0 both sides are zero after q_0-q_0 cancels; no denominator or finite minimum is introduced.
weighted_intermediate.source_relationship: This retains each individual gap and the terminal squared distance before the source inserts a common sInf gap and finally drops the terminal square. It is a derived strengthening/adaptation, not the literal displayed source theorem.

finite_horizon.set_conditions: For N>0, S_N is finite and nonempty, hence bounded below with its infimum attained. This is not the infimum over all E, and no global lower bound on f is assumed.
finite_horizon.weighted_minimum_step: Since m_N<=f(x_i) for each i<N and a_i>=0, A_N*(m_N-f(z))<=sum_{i<N}(a_i*delta_i), even when some gaps are negative.
finite_horizon.terminal_drop: q_N>=0 allows replacement of q_0+G^2*B_N-q_N by q_0+G^2*B_N.
finite_horizon.division_domain: N>0 and all a_i>0 give A_N>0, hence 2*A_N>0. Division by that positive number is valid. No positivity of the numerator or of f(x_i)-f(z) is needed.
finite_horizon.witness: Choose an index attaining the finite minimum, or use a positive-weight contradiction. Then some i<N satisfies delta_i<=(q_0+G^2*B_N)/(2*A_N).
finite_horizon.index_correspondence: The source uses i in range(k+1), so N=k+1. Conversely every positive N has k=N-1. The initial equality x(0)=x0 is eliminated by writing x(0) directly.
finite_horizon.comparator: z is arbitrary. It need not minimize f, be stationary, belong to an argmin set, or make the gaps nonnegative.
